premises.text: Heavy industry needs heat that is simultaneously cheap, reliable, and flame-hot; current zero-carbon options cannot deliver all three affordably
premises.evidence_span: There is no affordable way to decarbonize our heavy industries. Cement, steel, glass, the building blocks of our society all need a tremendous amount of energy. And that energy needs to be cheap, reliable, and hot, often hot as flames

premises.text: Joule Hive thermal battery stores cheap/abundant electricity as on-demand hot gas delivered to existing furnaces, boilers, and kilns
premises.evidence_span: This system takes in electricity from renewables or off-peak nuclear or hydro whenever it's cheap, whenever it's abundant, whenever it's available. We turn it into on-demand heat stored into the system

premises.text: Electrically conductive fire bricks (e-bricks) form a heater, thermal store, and heat exchanger that reach ~1,800°C cheaper than hydrogen and last longer than conventional electric heaters
premises.evidence_span: the electrically conductive fire brick, or e-bricks, if you like. These bricks are from normal refractory materials, normal bricks that line furnaces today. We use semiconductor doping to make them electrically conductive

premises.text: System is retrofittable onto existing industrial processes without radical plant redesign
premises.evidence_span: we're retrofitable. We can attach to your existing process, pipe in our hot gas to your furnace, your boiler, even your turbine

premises.text: In high-renewable regions, absorbing cheap/negative-priced power yields multi-year paybacks while cutting most site carbon versus gas or electric boilers
premises.evidence_span: in the Midwest, you can operate in areas today where 50% of the year, electricity is cheaper than natural gas as a heat source. We can pay back in five years while offsetting 80% of your carbon emissions

value.text: Affordable, reliable electrified heat that decarbonizes the hottest industries
value.evidence_span: decarbonize the hottest industries with electrified heat

causal_links.evidence_span: no affordable way to decarbonize our heavy industries
turn the power from those sources into reliable industrial heat
pay back in five years while offsetting 80% of your carbon emissions

notes: Hydrogen cost comparison and 1,800°C performance folded into P2/P3 as quantitative detail of the thermal-battery mechanism. Lab scale-up demo and pilot glow treated as validation, not premises. Customer LOI/pipeline and 2030 revenue vision excluded as traction/aspiration.
